name: 3C 322 (Hubble)
blurb: 3C 322, a powerful radio galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: 3c322-hubble
story: A distant galaxy whose heart drives some of the strongest radio emission of its time, seen in the cosmic Bright Ages. Hubble looked here to see how such an active nucleus shapes star birth in its host and surroundings, in a galaxy thought to be a forerunner of the giants at the centers of clusters.

claims.text: 3C 322 is a radio galaxy in the 3C high-redshift Hubble survey
3C322 was a target of Hubble program 13023 on powerful 3C radio sources
The program targeted the most powerful radio galaxies at their redshifts
The program is titled for the 'Bright Ages'
Such galaxies are thought to be progenitors of the most massive cluster ellipticals
The program asks how the active nucleus affects star formation
